summary.description: One-sentence summary of the workflow approach.

title.description: Short descriptive title of the step.

description.description: What this step must accomplish. Used as the step prompt when systemPrompt/userPromptTemplate are omitted.

systemPrompt.description: Highly specific system directive tailored for this task. Omit to fall back to description.

userPromptTemplate.description: The prompt template. Use {{step_id.output}} to reference outputs from parent steps. Omit to fall back to description.

intakeMode.description: Which parent outputs to append automatically to user text.

intakeSteps.description: Target step IDs to pull outputs from when mode is "some".

goal.description: Goal handoff: clean drops all direction, full re-injects the objective, moderated carries the full objective plus a handoff marker. Default full.

context.description: Context handoff: clean drops upstream/parent content, full passes it through, moderated compacts it to a summary. Default is engine-current.

tools.description: Tool belt: inherit the runner tools (default) or none for isolation.

handoff.description: Handoff modes for this step (goal/context/tools). Omit for defaults.

hitl.description: Set to true if this step should pause for manual operator approval.

assignee.description: Optional agent name when the step runs under the discussion engine (MAA swarm).

engine.description: Optional per-step engine override (default: the executor engine).

turns.description: Optional discussion turns for a discussion-engine step (default 1).

replaces.description: The id of a rejected step this step replaces: its surviving dependents are rewired onto this step. Omit otherwise.
